messages:
rachel: Heads-up — seeing rapid etcd leader flips in us-west controlplane starting ~06:14 UTC. Controller-manager keeps losing the lease and GPU onboarding jobs are piling up Pending.

infra-bot: [ALERT] etcd_leader_changes spike (us-west) count=18 in 5m; apiserver_5xx_rate rising

omar: Any infra changes last night? kernel, ntp, cloud agent?

kevin: We rolled a change to NTP client config across controlplane pool to enable more aggressive correction (slew vs step) — intended to reduce large jumps. Rolling out to some hosts might have caused transient negative skews.

rachel: Controller-manager logs show repeated renew failures and some timestamps look weird. Excerpt below (redacted pod ids):

```
E0401 06:14:09.112 leaderelection.go:243] failed to renew lease: timed out waiting for the condition
I0401 06:14:09.113 controller_manager.go:142] leader election lost: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded
I0401 06:14:09.215 leaderelection.go:210] attempting to acquire lease kube-system/controller-manager...
```

rachel: At the same window kernel time jumped backwards on host cp-07: `systemd[1]: Time has been changed` and `timedatectl` shows a ~3.2s negative offset on a subset of controlplane nodes.

omar: Negative jumps can make the controller think its lease is expired while etcd still sees the previous timestamp — results in dual contenders and frequent failovers. That would stall controllers that only run on leader.

kevin: Fast mitigations I recommend now:
- stop/disable NTP client on affected controlplane nodes to prevent additional adjustments (systemctl stop systemd-timesyncd)
- cordon cp-07 and drain controlplane pods off it, restart controller-manager on a healthy node to acquire stable lease
- temporarily bump leaderElection leaseDuration -> 70s, renewDeadline -> 50s in staging, then eu-west/us-west if stable
- add a probe / metric: consecutive_lease_renew_failures to alert before full leader loss

rachel: I cordoned cp-07 and restarted controller-manager there; leader stabilized after ~70s and reconciliation resumed. GPU onboarding backlog cleared slowly as controllers reconciled; most Pending GPU pods moved to Running within 6m.

omar: Cost impact: while we were degraded we routed ~75k tokens through hosted fallback over ~18m. Finance estimate incremental cost ~$210. Add to post-incident accounting.

kevin: Longer term actions:
- revert or rework the NTP client change; switch to a gradual slewing config verified in canary ASG
- add a preflight test for any time-sync changes: small cross-check to controlplane time endpoints and ensure offset < 100ms across pool
- instrument controller-manager with a lease-renew histogram and alert on 3 consecutive failures

rachel: I'll draft a short runbook section: "time-sync induced lease flapping -> leader election thrash" with commands to detect skew, emergency steps (stop timesync, cordon, restart controller-manager), and cost tagging. Assigning follow-ups:
- rachel: runbook + incident timeline
- kevin: revert NTP change and create canary playbook
- omar: add metric + alert for consecutive lease failures

infra-bot: incident-created: INC-20260401-401 (severity: medium). Runbook placeholder: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/time-sync-lease-flap

rachel: Will update after Kevin's revert and a staging test of leaseDuration bump. Thanks team :raised_hands:
